adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a test bug. Looking at the diff, EmbedController#best (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb lines 8-18) calls `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` when no topic_id is found, not TopicRetriever.new directly. However, the test in spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb lines 41-46 sets up `TopicRetriever.expects(:new).returns(retriever)` expecting TopicRetriever to be instantiated directly. Since the controller actually enqueues a job (Jobs::RetrieveTopic) which internally uses TopicRetriever, the mock expectation on TopicRetriever.new will never be satisfied in the controller action itself. This is a real test defect - the test is testing the wrong thing.
